verdict.summary: Round 3 closes every P0 and P1 this reviewer raised in round 2. R2-1 (stop_outcomes), R2-2 (KNOWLEDGE locators), R2-3 (requires) and R2-14 (prints under Grok's cut, render checks the budget) are fixed. Of 21 round-2 findings, 9 are fixed, 1 partly, 10 open (all P2/P3) and 1 wont-fix. Of 12 round-1 carry-overs, 4 are fixed, 4 partly and 4 open (all P2/P3). Decision 20 holds on the runtime main vendors and 2.6.0 ships (0.10.0). Start, next, done and the receipt carry Work, Exit and Repeat verbatim in their first 1.8K, and every gate anchor in the partials still renders and states its rule. The wording overclaims only for error packets, and E5 guards against the lean returns the Battleship install ran. The new problems are in the round-3 additions and the budget rule, not in decision 20: the considerations head and form do not give the eight keys the A0 gate demands; the ported guidance still says 'report revise'; and a renderer that refuses an over-budget print at emit would stall a run at a longer install, where today's engine degrades. Ready to land once its requires are met, after R3-1 and R3-3 (about +6 characters net) and an engine decision that emit degrades rather than refuses (R3-2).
top_changes: R3-1: print the A0 gate's eight keys (whole_step ... proof) in considerations-titles and the form; move the criterion-evidence anchor there and drop Method 4's first sentence (net about +6).
R3-2: the static validator refuses at a declared maximum install against 20,000; at emit the renderer shrinks to pointers and prints, never refuses, with the cut line when over 20,000.

R3-3 and R2-6: 'report send-back' in the considerations text; the fresh loop branch says 'If the Receipt below exists, do not start it: while it is active run its next_argv; once it is complete or stopped, submit this stage's result.' (+38).
